description: Use this when a Phorme coach asks about their own coaching brains: how many members train under each, who went quiet, what they have earned, and whether a note to members can go today. It reads only and changes nothing. It needs a connected Phorme account; an account without a coaching brain gets the address of the coach console.
name: get_my_coaching_business

brains.description: Each brain with status, member totals, quiet members (labels only), earnings in cents and whether a note may go today.

coach.description: Whether the account has an active coach plan.

title: Get my coaching brains
